items.t: Asian Games: China's Table Tennis Men Stunned by Japan in Team Final
items.s: Japan edged China 3-2 in the Asian Games men's table tennis team final, with Tomokazu Harimoto winning both of his matches. China still collected gold in shooting and advanced in singles, while the fencing team took bronze.

items.t: Asian Games Day Two: China's Shooters and Paddlers Shine in Hangzhou
items.s: China added gold in shooting and advanced its table tennis stars at the Hangzhou Asian Games, while the men's fencing team settled for bronze and skateboarding's defending champion slipped to eighth.
